# task\-sse\-event\-coverage — Broadcast core mutations to the SSE event hub

From the 2026\-08\-15 complete code audit: \`emitMutationEvent\` \(src/core/events\.ts:5\) is only ever called by the dashboard's own \`emit\(\)\` wrapper \(src/dashboard/server\.ts:70\)\. Core mutations \(\`createTask\`, \`claimTask\`, \`postMessage\`, \.\.\.\) append to events\.jsonl but never publish to the in\-process hub, so the dashboard's SSE live stream \(src/dashboard/server\.ts:639\) misses CLI/MCP\-driven changes\. Fix: publish a typed event from the core write path \(\`appendEventUnlocked\` or the mutation entry points\) so all surfaces' mutations appear live, or explicitly document the limitation if a hub emission from core is rejected\.
